recommendation: Keep the commit as the core FHIR reconciliation for FHIR-28495. If the work group wants transaction Bundle ifNoneMatch behavior or explicit CapabilityStatement2 discovery for wildcard-only update support, handle that as a separate scoped tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-28495 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution requesting support for If-None-Match: * on PUT [type]/[id] so a client can create a resource with a client-specified id while ensuring an existing resource is not replaced. The resolution also allowed servers to support only the wildcard variant and deferred discovery details to CapabilityStatement2 work.
initial_application: Historical commit 22e27816418f62634685e937808236683070c101 added If-None-Match prose to source/http.html, but placed it under conditional update and led with an ETag-specific W/"[ETag]" example. Later edits fixed nearby wording but did not move the guidance to the update-as-create use case approved by the issue.
additional_context: The cited Zulip thread and the 2020 FHIR-I minutes both describe the change as an idempotent client-assigned-id create using PUT Patient/123 with If-None-Match: *. A 2022 FHIR-I note and the Jira comment say the CapabilityStatement discovery portion should be handled through a new CapabilityStatement2 tracker. A later Zulip transaction-Bundle question showed ambiguity around Bundle.entry.request.ifNoneMatch, but no final Jira decision was found for that surface.
reconciliation: Edited source/http.html to point the If-None-Match header table at Update as Create, add the If-None-Match: * update-as-create precondition and 412 failure behavior, state that servers may support only the wildcard variant for update-as-create, remove the misplaced conditional-update ETag paragraph, and list If-None-Match in the update summary row.
source_changes: source/http.html: Updated the If-None-Match HTTP header table row to link to Update as Create instead of Conditional Update.
source/http.html: Added Update as Create guidance for If-None-Match: *, including 412 Precondition Failed when the target resource already exists and wildcard-only server support.
source/http.html: Removed the misleading conditional update paragraph that described If-None-Match with a W/"[ETag]" example.
source/http.html: Updated the REST interaction summary table so the update row lists If-None-Match alongside If-Match.
